---
title: Vendor Account Deletions
description: Handle partner-app vendor requests to delete their account — call, refund unused credits, then approve or reject.
---

## Overview

**Sidebar:** Vendors → Roster → **Account Deletions** (`/vendors/account-deletions`)

Partner-app vendors can ask to delete their account. Each request lands here for an admin to handle.

<Callout kind="alert">

Approving a deletion **permanently erases** the vendor's profile, documents, chats and cashboy accounts. Orders and payments are kept against an anonymous vendor. This cannot be undone.

</Callout>

## Status tabs

**Pending** (default) · **Deleted** · **Rejected** · **Cancelled by vendor** · **All**

## Table

| Column | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| Vendor | The vendor who requested deletion — name, shop · city, phone and the request ID (CKDEL-…). |
| Reason | Reason given in the partner app (e.g. "I am not getting enough orders"). |
| Requested | When the request was made, plus "Decided *date*" once it has been handled. |
| Wallet | Unused credit balance at the time of the request ("*n* at request"). |
| Status | Pending, Deleted, Rejected or Cancelled (cancelled by the vendor). |

Empty states: "No requests waiting." (Pending) or "Nothing here."

## How to handle a request

<Steps>
  <Step title="Call the vendor" icon="phone" title-type="p">
    Confirm the request and the reason. Many requests can be resolved without deleting the account.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Refund unused credits" icon="wallet" title-type="p">
    Check the **Wallet** column and refund any unused credits before deciding.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Approve or reject" icon="check-circle" title-type="p">
    Approve to erase the account (irreversible), or reject to keep it. A vendor can also cancel their own request, which moves it to **Cancelled by vendor**.
  </Step>
</Steps>
